# The frontoparietal latent-change analysis is EXPLORATORY

## load packages and data

```{r message=F}
rm(list = ls())

library(lavaan) # v.0.6-21
library(here) # v.1.0.1
library(dplyr) # v.1.2.1 

# background 
load(here("Analysis_data", "df_frontoparietal.Rda"))
df_frontoparietal <- rename(df_frontoparietal, "SI" = "–SI")

# resting-state
load(here("Analysis_data", "df_frontoparietal_rest.Rda"))
df_frontoparietal_rest <- rename(df_frontoparietal_rest, "SI" = "–SI")

# task-evoked
load(here("Analysis_data", "df_frontoparietal_rawfunc.Rda"))
df_frontoparietal_rawfunc <- rename(df_frontoparietal_rawfunc, "SI" = "–SI")

df <- df_frontoparietal %>%
  left_join(
    df_frontoparietal_rawfunc %>%
      select(
        Subject,
        DE_rawfunc = DE,
        SI_rawfunc = SI,
        PT_rawfunc = PT,
        RE_rawfunc = RE,
        C_rawfunc = C
      ),
    by = "Subject"
  )

df_rest <- df_frontoparietal_rest %>%
  left_join(
    df_frontoparietal_rawfunc %>%
      select(
        Subject,
        DE_rawfunc = DE,
        SI_rawfunc = SI,
        PT_rawfunc = PT,
        RE_rawfunc = RE,
        C_rawfunc = C
      ),
    by = "Subject"
  )

```



## Coupling and Intelligence LC from Background FC to task-evoked FC

```{r}
SCFC_int_model <- '
## coupling model -> we take the exact same model specification as in the earlier frontoparietal models, residual variance of C and C_rawfunc set to zero to match model in STATS5_SCFC_frontoparietal (negative variance)
coupling =~ SI + PT + RE + C + DE
RE ~~ DE
PT ~~ DE
C ~~ 0*C

coupling_rawfunc =~ SI_rawfunc + PT_rawfunc + RE_rawfunc + C_rawfunc + DE_rawfunc
RE_rawfunc ~~ DE_rawfunc
PT_rawfunc ~~ DE_rawfunc
C_rawfunc ~~ 0*C_rawfunc

SI ~~	SI_rawfunc
PT ~~ PT_rawfunc
RE ~~ RE_rawfunc
#C ~~ C_rawfunc # cannot correlate because variances of both variables were set to zero
DE ~~ DE_rawfunc



# autoregressive path
coupling_rawfunc ~ 1*coupling 

# residual variance of coupling_rawfunc to zero
coupling_rawfunc ~~ 0*coupling_rawfunc

# latent change factor
change =~ 1*coupling_rawfunc

# covariance of coupling and change 
coupling ~~ change

## intelligence model
int =~ BIS + equal("int=~BIS")*APM

BIS =~ PC_Mean + PS_Mean + C_Mean + M_Mean

APM =~ PropCorrOdd + equal("APM=~PropCorrOdd")*PropCorrEven


## structural model
int ~ change
'

fit_SCFC_int <- sem(SCFC_int_model, data = df,
                      missing = "ML")

summary(fit_SCFC_int, fit.measures = T, standardized = TRUE)

zFit <- standardizedsolution(fit_SCFC_int)
regressions <- subset(zFit, op == "~")
correlations <- subset(zFit, op == "~~")

inspect(fit_SCFC_int, "r2")
```
